notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.1
Hi everyone,
I've updated the game with the following changes:
- Performance improvements.
- You can slow down the game as long as you hold the space bar. This can be used 20s in a level. You can gain slow down time by collecting coins and stars.
- You can limit the FPS in the settings menu now. The FPS are limited to 60 while loading.
- You can see a small animation on the coin and start counter when you have collected all coins or stars in a level.
Thanks for playing!
